The '''Furrow''' was a model of [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] produced by [[Vectron]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Vectron Furrow was added to the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] with patch 5.3. and is available from the Armed Resistance Pack.
